A slip: a printed strip showing the card type line and its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-ketmaliss-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Ket Maliss]]: The game text changes: “any” becomes “your”; “any” becomes “your”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a white italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
